{
"score_team_1": 2,
"score_team_2": 0,
"team1_win_probability": 70,
"draw_probability": 18,
"team2_win_probability": 12,

"white_hat": "Objective evidence favors Argentina: they enter tournaments with recent major-tournament success, a deep squad and strong attacking metrics. Austria are a well-organised European side with solid qualifying form and good set-piece threat. Historically Argentina rank among the tournament favorites while Austria are an underdog. Head-to-heads are limited; home venue, travel and tournament scheduling also affect fatigue and selection but raw quality and experience favor Argentina on balance.",

"red_hat": "Intuitively the emotional dynamic favors Argentina: confident, hungry for title defense and supported by global expectation, their players often raise intensity under pressure. Austria will be spirited, disciplined and eager to prove themselves, brimming with team cohesion and belief. Momentum, national pride, and a few inspirational individuals can swing moments, so the match-feel is high-stakes with Argentina likely carrying the weight of expectation and Austria motivated as challengers.",

"black_hat": "Risks that could overturn the forecast include key Argentina injuries, unexpected tactical mismatches, a surprise aggressive plan from Austria, early red cards or VAR decisions, and complacency from favorites. Tournament variables — travel fatigue, acclimatisation, and rotation choices — increase uncertainty. Austria’s set-piece proficiency and compact defensive system could frustrate Argentina and produce low-scoring outcomes, while penalty or single-moment events could produce an upset.",

"yellow_hat": "Reasons supporting Argentina’s predicted win: superior attacking talent, creative midfield control, experienced game management and depth for substitutions. Argentina exploit transitions and high-quality finishing; they can control possession and create high-quality chances. Austria’s strengths — organisation and set pieces — still permit Argentina to find spaces on the counter or through incisive passes. Overall strategic advantages, bench quality and big-match experience favor Argentina converting chances into goals.",

"green_hat": "Creative and unconventional scenarios that could influence the match include Austria adopting an extreme low-block counter-pressing plan that yields one scrappy goal and forces Argentina to overcommit; an early red card for either side changing game dynamics; a young Argentina substitute bursts onto the scene; goalkeeping heroics or a bizarre VAR overturn swing momentum; weather, pitch condition or tactical masterstrokes could produce a markedly different scoreline than expected.",

"blue_hat": "Synthesis and final judgment combines all hats: from the white hat I weight objective evidence highest (roughly 40%) pointing to Argentina superiority; the yellow hat (20%) reinforces strengths and scoring capability; the black hat (20%) cautions about upset paths and single-event volatility; the red hat (10%) adds momentum and emotional weight favoring Argentina; the green hat (10%) preserves low-probability disruptive scenarios. Integrating these leads to a cautious but confident forecast: Argentina 2, Austria 0. Probability allocation reflects this mix: 70% Argentina win acknowledging the black-hat uncertainty and green-hat upset routes, 18% draw for a tight tactical stalemate, 12% Austria win as a plausible upset. The predicted scoreline assumes Argentina convert a couple of quality chances while maintaining defensive discipline, with Austria dangerous on set pieces but ultimately contained." 
}
